caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Your phone screen isn't 'seeing' your finger... it's *feeling* your electricity!

Here's the mind-blowing reality of how touchscreens work:
🔹 Every modern screen has an invisible electrical 'skin' that's constantly scanning.
🔹 Your finger naturally carries a tiny static electric charge.
🔹 When you touch, this charge creates a ripple in the screen's field, allowing it to pinpoint your exact tap!

💬 Did you already know your screen felt your electricity, or did this blow your mind? Drop a 🤯 in the comments!
